name: Blumira
summary: Blumira sells a SIEM with managed detection and automated response, priced per employee per month. Detect is $12, Respond $16 and Automate $21 on the pricing page, with annual service terms and a 30-day trial on Automate only.

facts.text: Cloud connectors and on-premises sensors are listed for all plans, but the page does not state how many log sources each plan supports.
Data ingestion is unlimited on all plans, and retention is one year on all plans.
Managed detection, detection filters, detection rule management and custom detections are listed as features, without a count of detection rules.
Only the Automate plan has a stated trial, which is 30 days. The page gives no trial pricing or payment terms.
Additional Blumira Agents cost $3 per agent a month on every edition.
A one-time white-glove onboarding fee is $250 on Detect and $500 on Respond, and it is included on Automate.

plans.name: Detect
plans.notes: Employees are knowledge workers with a corporate email address and a workstation or device. Onboarding fee of $250 applies.

plans.name: Respond
plans.notes: Includes one Blumira Agent per employee. Onboarding fee of $500 applies.

plans.name: Automate
plans.notes: Includes one Blumira Agent per employee and onboarding. Includes a 30-day trial and automated threat containment.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page shows dollar signs without naming a currency code.
Service terms are annual, with multi-year options. The price labels say per month.
Additional Blumira Agents cost $3 per agent a month on all editions.
Volume, nonprofit, government and education discounts are handled through sales, and no figures are given.
